input.quote: 3.1 The Company shall pay HDI thirty percent (3016) of the Net Sales in excess of Eleven Thousand Dollars ($11,000) per calendar month. "Net Sales" shall mean all revenues from the sale of Deerskin Products on the Site including shipping and handling charges, minus refunds and exchanges.
input.rationale: The fee construct meets the preferred position: the Company's only payment obligation is a 30% share of actual Net Sales above an $11,000 monthly threshold, i.e. purely usage/revenue-based with no guaranteed minimum, minimum hosting fee, committed volume or shortfall/take-or-pay mechanic anywhere in Section 3. The $11,000 figure operates as a floor below which no fee is payable (a benefit to us), not as a minimum commitment. Section 4.1 also gives a one-year term with annual renewal terminable by either Party on 90 days' notice, so there is no multi-year lock-in without an exit. Noted but not flagged here: the Section 4.2 Termination Payment (trailing 12-month Net Sales less $800,000, halved) is an exit cost rather than a purchase commitment or shortfall penalty, and is better addressed under the termination-fee rule; the Section 6.1 exclusivity covenant is likewise a scope restriction rather than a volume cap, and is reviewed under the exclusivity rule. No redline required.
